researcherObservation: R06 canonicalization test fails on desktop/mobile: history length grows from2 to3 when applying semantically unchanged noncanonical default parameters. Authored App.tsx line32 assigns window.location.hash whenever raw hash strings differ; it does not distinguish canonicalization from a semantic state change. This is one duplicated cause, not two independent requirement failures.
